Unavailable lookup: retain last state.
Confirmed absence can fail after 10 minutes.
Source SHA, branch and workflow must match.

span.p:
Failure can follow partial S3 writes.
Retry handoff or identity can also fail.
Eligible retry creates a new tracking row.
Terminal records do not reopen.
